description: Intent i006 (SNAPSHOT=s02, BRANCH=debugfs-write-memdup-sscanf) complete. Searched only snapshots/s02. Four findings written to agent-state/findings/i006.json, all validated-equals-used invariant violations in debugfs write handlers: (1) drivers/net/ethernet/brocade/bna/bnad_debugfs.c:314-320 bnad_debugfs_write_regrd — memdup_user(buf, nbytes) allocates exactly nbytes with no terminator, then sscanf(kern_buf, "%x:%x", &addr, &len) scans for NUL past the allocation; the seed's exact structural clone in the sibling Brocade bna driver (upstream fixed bfa with memdup_user_nul in commit 13d0cecb4626). (2) Same file lines 374-380, bnad_debugfs_write_regwr, identical pattern. (3) drivers/s390/cio/cio_inject.c:98-103 crw_inject_write — vmemdup_user(buf, lbuf) then sscanf(buffer, "%x %x %x %x %x %x %x", ...) with kvfree only after the scan; no NUL slot. (4) drivers/scsi/qedf/qedf_debugfs.c:173-178 qedf_dbg_debug_cmd_write — memdup_user(buffer, count) then kstrtouint(kern_buf, 10, &val) without terminator (medium confidence). All four quotes verified literal within their reported ranges; untrusted debugfs sources (regrd 0644, regwr 0200, crw_inject 0200, qedf debug 0600) and absence of any terminator enforcement between copy and string use were confirmed by reading each complete function. Eight candidates rejected with concrete evidence: scsi_debug.c (kzalloc(count+1)), i40e_debugfs.c (kzalloc(count+1)+cmd_buf[count]=0), rvu_debugfs.c (memdup_user(count+1)+cmd_buf[count]=0), hfi1 (memdup_user_nul; binary i2c paths), btrfs ioctl resize (memchr NUL check), rtw89 (hex2bin bounded; copy_from_user variants terminated), mlx5 outlen_write (count>6 + zeroed array), wil6210 (binary frame use). Bounded negative evidence: cross-filter of 202 memdup_user/vmemdup_user hits and a copy_from_user→string-op window scan over all 70 debugfs-creating files showed every other debugfs write handler either terminates (buf[n]=0 / count+1 alloc / zeroed array) or consumes buffers as bounded binary. Limitations: no runtime KASAN harness run (Qedf kstrtouint scan behavior unverified at runtime); exploitability requires the drivers loaded and debugfs nodes reachable; kstrto*_from_user/simple_write_to_buffer helpers not individually audited; sysfs/proc/ioctl branches belong to intents i007-i009; the seed bfa file itself (unfixed at s02 lines 253/320) was excluded as demonstration-only.
